newsitem.title: USA: Some U.S. beef, hog plants to be closed Monday.
newsitem.headline: Some U.S. beef, hog plants to be closed Monday.

text.p: Some U.S. beef and pork plants will be closed Monday in observance of the U.S. President's Day holiday, according to company officials.

IBP Inc said its beef plants in Dakota City, Neb., Boise, Idaho, and Pasco, Wash. will be closed. The company said its eight other beef plants and its seven pork plants were scheduled to operate Monday.
Farmland Industries said its hog and pork plants in Crete, Neb., Denison, Iowa and Monmouth, Ill., will be closed.
A Hormel Foods Corp spokesman said its Oklahoma City packaged foods plant and a Stockton, Calif., canned food plant will be closed. It's three pork plants will operate.
Smithfield Foods said its four pork plants will be operating, as will two other pork plants operated by its subsidiary, John Morrell and Co.
National Beef Packing Co, a subsidiary of Farmland Industries, said its Liberal and Dodge City, Kan., plants will operate Monday.
A ConAgra Inc spokeswoman was researching Friday if any of its three Monfort beef plants or three Swift and Co pork plants will be closed Monday.
Officials were unavailable to comment about plant operations at Excel Corp, a division of Cargill Inc, which operates six beef and three pork plants.
